fact: mTOMADY says DHIS2 is the national health data system used by the Ministry of Public Health in Madagascar.
USAID ACCESS says CommCare integrates its data into Madagascar's national health information management system, which also receives community health volunteers' Monthly Activity Reports.

CommCare, which covers care, surveillance and reporting including COVID-19 and plague tracking, integrates its data into the national health information management system, per USAID ACCESS and Dimagi.
